ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from selecting 'Yes' for 'Enter to True Link now?' unless a Beneficiary ID is present.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Beneficiary ID is required before selecting 'Yes' for 'Enter to True Link now?'. Go to the Lead related to this Onboarding and click the Convert button so the Lead becomes a Beneficiary (Account). The Beneficiary ID will be automatically generated.
